import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String userInput = scanner.nextLine();
        StringBuilder modified = new StringBuilder();

        // Append first character
        modified.append(userInput.charAt(0));
        // Replace "dot" with "." in the middle part
        String middlePart = userInput.substring(1, userInput.length() - 1).replace("dot", ".");
        modified.append(middlePart);
        // Append last character
        modified.append(userInput.charAt(userInput.length() - 1));

        String result = modified.toString();

        // Replace first occurrence of "at" with "@"
        int atIndex = result.indexOf("at");
        if (atIndex != -1) {
            result = result.substring(0, atIndex) + "@" + result.substring(atIndex + 2);
        }

        System.out.println(result);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
